Frequently Asked Questions
What is Podium AI Employee?
Podium AI Employee is an AI-powered part of the Podium platform that helps you capture leads, respond faster, handle repetitive communication work, and support conversion across the customer journey.
How is it different from a chatbot?
AI Employee does more than sit on your website and answer basic questions. It helps manage conversations across the customer journey and works within Podium’s broader communication platform.
Can I customize how it responds?
Yes. With playbooks and AI Studio, you can guide workflows, shape responses, and improve how AI Employee performs over time.
Is it only for one type of business?
No. AI Employee is built for service businesses broadly, with deeper industry-specific examples and experiences available on vertical pages.
Can it work for both single and multi-location businesses?
Yes. Podium supports businesses at different levels of scale, from single-location teams to larger operators.
How do I see if it’s right for my industry?
You can explore the industry-specific AI Employee pages to see tailored examples, messaging, and proof.
